verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents that it speaks the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface, so SQL-level work (DDL, inserts, queries) can be driven programmatically. Agents can also list services, run SQL and read monitoring through its official MCP server, and CHKit offers typed commands for deploying schema and pipelines. The evidence never shows a documented public management API for creating or resizing clusters, configuring alerts or handling access, so programmatic control beyond SQL is unproven. Missing for 10: a documented public control-plane/management API (e.g. REST with reference docs) covering clusters, branches, alerts and access, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API-driven use.
